title: デイリー杯ジュニアSの後に・次なる牙

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Huff… huff… huff… I did it. But…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer was right! That brilliant last surge of hers was truly formidable!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: That was quite the battle! Seeking the Pearl certainly lived up to her reputation, but what's more…

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright ran better than expected! The intensity of her final spurt was on an entirely new level!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My prediction was right. Mejiro Bright's running was nothing like it was before, and not only that…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Doctor, what kind of spell did you cast on her?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright's legs are still weak, so she shouldn't be able to run like that, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Physical Therapist
text_block_list.text: I didn't use any magic. Her legs simply developed on their own. However…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Physical Therapist
text_block_list.text: We've been continually preparing her so she would be able to adjust to her growth right away. That's why she was able to run so well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I see. Then perhaps I can do the same…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Physical Therapist
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course. Our team can conduct the same analyses on you and develop exercises to help bring out your best potential.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Physical Therapist
text_block_list.text: After many years of working with the Mejiro family, we have more than enough knowledge and know-how to optimize everything for you.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer! There's something I want to talk to you about…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hello, Pearl.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Dober?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober, a cool and beautiful Umamusume from the Mejiro family with a bright future, suddenly approaches us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl had said the Mejiros were nothing to be afraid of, but now I see her face tighten ever so slightly with tension.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Pearl, now that you've run against Bright, I'm next.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: She ran well today, and thanks to that, she gave me a hint on what I should do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: As a member of the Mejiro family, I swear to surpass you.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "As a member… of the Mejiro family…"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: What a terrifying family… I best one of you, and another one immediately appears to take her place.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But I can't run away from your challenge, not as someone who seeks to show the world my possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer, what's the biggest and baddest junior-year race we can run in?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even while cornered, Seeking the Pearl asks for my opinion. Of course, the answer is a G1 race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Distance-wise, it's either the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies or the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes. Both of them are mile races, but if we're planning to go after the Triple Tiara, then…
choice_data_list: I think the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies would be a good choice.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: The Hanshin Juvenile Fillies… That's a great suggestion. I think a mile race would be easier for us to compete in.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That's one month from now. Will that be all right with you, Pearl?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Of course it is. It doesn't matter when or where we run.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: All that matters is that we're both there. Wouldn't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm in real danger now, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: If I don't do something, Dober's going to shred me to pieces.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Perhaps. But I'll admit I underestimated the power of a family that reigns over the Umamusume world…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I thought they were nothing more than racers who shared the same name, but today I learned how dangerous it is to be ignorant of their strength.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I can't go up against her as I am now…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: So let's put on our detective hats instead! We need to spend this next month uncovering the truth about Umamusume families!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Of course, I've always known about the existence of Umamusume families.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Seeking the Pearl seems to think that if we don't learn more about them before the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies, we'll be at a disadvantage.
